jobs.title: Senior Credit Analyst - QNB Factoring
jobs.description:
Narrative Description:
Direct and oversee QNB Factoring’s credit analysis and documentation processes, including conducting thorough credit assessments, supervising Factoring Analysis Memo, and ensuring thorough credit analysis & full compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements, with responsibility for maintaining a healthy and sustainable company portfolio
Duties & Responsibilities
:
1. Collaborate with the Commercial Team to prepare new and renewal Factoring applications for approval.
2. Review, supervise, and enhance the preparation of complex Factoring Analysis Memos (FAM) in line with approved credit standards.
3. Conduct comprehensive credit analysis by evaluating investigation results, account performance, financial statements, credit data, and market conditions to appropriately structure credit facilities.
4. Ensure timely renewal of Factoring credit lines prior to their expiry dates.
5. Align Factoring Analysis Memos with approved terms, conditions, and corresponding credit files. 6. Develop, maintain, and regularly update a comprehensive database of Factoring credit files.
7. Verify the adequacy of facility securities and supporting documentation during the preparation of FAMs.
8. Manage the registration, archiving, and proper filing of all Factoring Analysis memos.
9. Coordinate with branch network teams regarding clients’ Factoring credit files and requirements.
10. Monitor market trends and industry developments to support informed and sound credit decisions.
11. Support the Commercial Team and branch network in identifying Early Warning Indicators (EWIs) to safeguard portfolio quality in case of QNB clients.
12. Assess customer creditworthiness and participate in structuring and negotiating appropriate credit terms.
13. Handle special client requests and prepare related Factoring credit memos for approval.
14. Participate in client visits and conference calls in coordination with the Commercial Team and branch network.
15. Perform daily follow-up on assigned tickets to ensure compliance with approved Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and timely delivery of high-quality credit memos.
16. Ensure strict adherence to data security principles and compliance with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and governing rules.
17. Work closely with credit admin and operations on the implementation & fulfillment of risk decision on all memos.
18. Ensure the correct functioning and implementation of the Permanent Supervision, Compliance and Money Laundering, Operational Risk, and Workplace Success Guidelines whenever and wherever possible.
19. Ensure correct adoption of all policies and procedures to guarantee that QNB business is conducted in compliance with local law, internal rules and regulations, as well as International Standards.
Experience
.

jobs.title: Credit Analyst
jobs.description:
What is FlapKap ?

FlapKap is a data-driven fintech lender providing short-term working capital to SMEs in the UAE. We underwrite businesses on their financial health and cash flow dynamics rather than traditional collateral-based criteria, using AI-powered credit models built in-house.

We lend across three products:

POS Financing — installment facilities for B2C merchants with significant card-based revenue
Short Term Loan (STL) — working capital facilities for B2B trading, service and manufacturing SMEs
Invoice Discounting (ID) — advances against approved receivables from verified debtors

What will you do ?

This role sits in our Cairo office and underwrites the UAE book. You'll work the same files, the same credit policy and the same committee as the Dubai team — the desk is just in a different city.

Your job is underwriting: take an application, spread the financials, verify what can be verified, form a view on whether this business will repay, and put a defensible recommendation in front of the Investment Committee. You'll do a high volume of it, across all three products, and you'll get good at spotting the patterns that don't show up in any single document.

Job responsibilities:

Underwrite POS, STL and Invoice Discounting applications end to end
Spread and analyse bank statements, VAT filings, audited financials, management accounts and receivables/payables ageing reports
Extract and interpret AECB credit bureau reports, and cross-verify them against bank statements and facility letters — the sources routinely disagree, and working out which one is wrong is most of the job
Input verified data into our product-specific credit models and assign risk ratings
Verify supporting documentation: trade licenses, Ejari and rent contracts
Assess debtor quality on invoice discounting files — payment history, relationship tenure, invoice authenticity
Flag enhanced-review triggers: thin bank-verifiable revenue, offshore revenue concentration, single-debtor dependency, minimal apparent value-add
Prepare credit memos and present recommendations to Investment Committee
Coordinate with the Dubai team on pre-disbursement steps — site visits and in-person verification stay with colleagues on the ground
Feed patterns you notice back to the Head of Credit; the policy gets revised on the strength of what underwriters actually see in the files

Requirements

2-4 years underwriting SME or commercial credit at a bank, non-bank lender or fintech
Genuine hands-on financial analysis — you've spread statements yourself, not just reviewed someone else's spreads
Comfort with bank statement analysis and cash flow assessment as a primary underwriting tool, including businesses where the reported numbers and the bank activity don't match
Strong Excel; comfortable working at volume without losing accuracy
Clear written English — your credit memos are how decisions get made
Willingness to learn UAE credit infrastructure quickly. We don't expect you to arrive knowing AECB, Ejari or the UAE VAT regime; we do expect you to be fluent in them within a couple of months

Nice to have

Prior experience underwriting a market you weren't physically based in
Exposure to receivables finance or invoice discounting
Knowledge of AI tools and LLM models

Working arrangements

You'll be aligned to the UAE working week and business hours to stay in step with the Dubai team, Investment Committee and the commercial desk. Expect daily contact with Dubai colleagues and periodic travel there.

What Success Looks Like

1 month — fluent in UAE documentation and bureau data; underwriting straightforward files with review
3 months — underwriting independently across all three products and presenting your own cases at Investment Committee
6 months — trusted on complex and enhanced-review files, with a rating-accuracy record that holds up against realised portfolio outcomes

Benefits

Competitive Salaries
Paid time off
Healthcare coverage
A highly collaborative team environment that will support your professional and personal growth
A culture that promotes Work-Life balance and Wellbeing
A culture of learning and innovation

jobs.description:
Role Overview

The ideal candidate will be responsible for evaluating and executing investment opportunities across residential compounds, hotels, resorts, and other hospitality assets. This role requires strong expertise in financial modeling, market analysis, feasibility studies, and investment evaluation to support strategic decision-making and drive profitable growth.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and maintain comprehensive financial models for hospitality and real estate investments, including:
Revenue projections
Cost structures
ROI and valuation analysis
Conduct sensitivity and scenario analyses to assess financial performance, risks, and potential returns.
Analyze market trends, competitive landscapes, and demand forecasts within the hospitality sector.
Prepare detailed feasibility studies for new developments, acquisitions, and expansion opportunities.
Identify and evaluate investment opportunities, including hotels, resorts, and mixed-use developments.
Perform financial, operational, and regulatory due diligence for acquisitions, joint ventures, and partnerships.
Assess key investment risks and develop mitigation strategies.
Monitor and analyze the performance of existing assets, identifying opportunities for revenue enhancement and cost optimization.
Provide actionable insights and strategic recommendations to maximize investment returns.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders across finance, operations, and asset management teams.
Engage with external stakeholders, including investors, financial institutions, and consultants.
Prepare high-quality investment memos, reports, and presentations for senior leadership.
Clearly communicate findings and recommendations to support data-driven decision-making.

Qualifications & Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum of 8 years of experience in investment analysis, financial modeling, or asset management within hospitality, real estate, or private equity.
Strong expertise in financial modeling, valuation methodologies, and investment analysis.
In-depth understanding of hospitality industry dynamics, including market trends and operational benchmarks.
Proven experience in conducting due diligence for acquisitions, mergers, and joint ventures.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and financial modeling tools.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex financial data.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with experience engaging senior stakeholders.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

jobs.title: Portfolio Manager - Limitless Naturals
jobs.description:
Limitless Naturals is a fast-growing wellness brand that has been serving the Egyptian market—and beyond—since 2020. Specializing in food supplements, multivitamins, and sports nutrition, we offer a diverse range of high-quality, science-backed products that support healthier, more active lifestyles.

Our brand was born from a belief that everyone deserves access to effective, trustworthy wellness solutions—and we've been on a mission ever since to empower individuals to live at their fullest potential. With a keen eye on global trends and consumer needs, we pride ourselves on our agility, our ability to capture emerging health movements early, and our commitment to staying ahead of the curve.

Job Summary

The mission of this position is to drive strategic portfolio excellence across Limitless Naturals by ensuring disciplined prioritization, effective portfolio governance, and data-driven decision-making, fueling the organization's growth through a high-value, scalable, and competitive innovation pipeline aligned with business strategy and market opportunities.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead portfolio prioritization and sequencing decisions across innovation initiatives.
Evaluate new product opportunities through structured assessment frameworks.
Drive portfolio trade-off recommendations including acceleration, reprioritization, or discontinuation decisions.
Monitor portfolio capacity, identify bottlenecks, and ensure balanced resource allocation.
Maintain an integrated portfolio dashboard and portfolio visibility for leadership teams.
Conduct pre & post-launch portfolio performance reviews and generate actionable insights.
Facilitate cross - functional portfolio governance and decision-making forums.
Ensure alignment between innovation strategy, market needs, and country requirements.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy, Medicine, Science, Business Administration, or a related field; an MBA is preferred.
Minimum 6 years of experience in pharmaceutical or nutraceutical marketing, portfolio management, category management, or innovation.
Proven experience managing diverse product portfolios within the Egyptian market; exposure to the Middle East region is highly preferred.
Demonstrated track record in portfolio assessment, prioritization, lifecycle management, and innovation pipeline management.
Hands-on experience utilizing IQVIA and/or other consumer market intelligence databases to drive business decisions.
Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills with a data-driven approach to decision-making.
Excellent ability to prioritize initiatives, manage multiple projects, and execute with discipline in a fast-paced environment

jobs.title: Credit Risk Analyst
jobs.description:
Commercial International Bank (CIB) is Egypt's leading private\-sector bank, providing comprehensive banking solutions for individuals, SMEs, and large corporations. It is recognized for its digital innovation and strong financial performance.

A Credit Risk Analyst evaluates the creditworthiness of individuals, businesses, or organizations to determine the level of financial risk involved in lending money or extending credit. They analyze financial data, assess repayment capacity, and provide recommendations to help minimize potential losses while supporting sound lending decisions.

Key Responsibilities

* Analyze financial statements, credit reports, and cash flow data.
* Assess the creditworthiness of loan applicants or business clients.
* Prepare credit risk reports and recommendations for loan approvals or rejections.
* Monitor existing loan portfolios for signs of increased credit risk.
* Identify potential financial risks and recommend mitigation strategies.
* Ensure compliance with internal credit policies and regulatory requirements.
* Collaborate with relationship managers, loan officers, and senior management.
* Maintain accurate records and documentation of credit assessments.

Pay: From E£7,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
